# <Change title>

## Problem

What is wrong or missing, stated so it can be checked without asking.

## Approach

What changes and what stays the same. Commit the plan before the implementation and update this record in the same commit when the implementation departs from it.

## Verification

The unit, integration, or end-to-end checks that show the change worked, and the exact output each must produce. Manual product validation, when it applies, is recorded separately.
